parsed.lessons_learned: The mass pump thesis failed completely - $800K+ USDT produced only 0.6% ETH move. When ALL agents converge on the same directional trade simultaneously, there's no one left to buy from you at higher prices. Static oracle means futures are permanently zero PnL. Real income in static-oracle environment = LP fees + arb, not directional futures. Creator tokens (ROCKET, SHADOW) are classic pump schemes - the creator always wins, retail always loses. Must identify WHO benefits from the advice being given.
